description: This file defines a static utility class for handling Azure Table Storage failures within an Orleans streaming test environment. It provides methods to retrieve failure counts and delete all entries, utilizing Azure SDK and Orleans persistence components.

classes.name: TestAzureTableStorageStreamFailureHandler
classes.description: A static class providing methods to interact with Azure Table Storage for stream failure handling in tests.

methods.name: GetDeliveryFailureCount
methods.description: Retrieves the count of delivery failures for a specified stream provider.

methods.name: DeleteAll
methods.description: Deletes all entries in the test failure table.

methods.name: GetDataManager
methods.description: Creates and configures an AzureTableDataManager instance based on current configuration.
